description: This file defines an interface for storage events and an internal class for batching transactional storage operations within the Orleans distributed virtual actor framework. It manages preparation, confirmation, cancellation, commit, collection, and related follow-up actions for transactional state storage.

classes.name: StorageBatch
classes.description: A batch processor for storage events associated with transactional state, capable of accumulating, executing, and managing storage operations and their preconditions.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores the batch of transactional state events into external storage.

methods.name: RunFollowUpActions
methods.description: Executes all follow-up actions queued during batch processing.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Logs a read event at a specific timestamp, updating metadata if newer.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Adds a prepare event for a transaction with associated state.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Records a cancellation of a transaction prepare identified by sequence number.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms a transaction at a specific sequence number, removing superseded prepares.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Records a commit for a transaction, adding commit records to metadata.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Removes commit records associated with a transaction from metadata.

methods.name: FollowUpAction
methods.description: Adds a follow-up action to be executed after batch storage.

methods.name: AddStorePreCondition
methods.description: Adds an asynchronous precondition that must be true before storage.

methods.name: CheckStorePreConditions
methods.description: Evaluates all store preconditions; returns true if all are satisfied.
